sampling: Deterministic hash ordering, balanced by source label; original source partitions respected.
limitations: Binary labels only; no CWE classification, severity, or fix labels are present.
Upstream labels not individually verified by PatchReason.
Original data derived from CVEfixes; overlapping CVEfixes examples must never cross training/evaluation partitions.
Exact whitespace-normalized duplicate controls do not detect semantic near duplicates.
Foundation model pretraining overlap cannot be excluded.
Balanced classes do not represent real-world prevalence.
Public code origin and per-repository redistribution/training rights remain to be reviewed.
Training the classifier does not establish security code-review performance.
